non_goals: No production config or schema mutations
No real number purchases, outbound calls or provider subaccount creation during verification
Do not audit secondary OpenAI or secondary PSTN flows

Upload, paste and saved-list campaign paths retain mapped fields with a compact review flow
Local verification setup diagnoses prerequisites and can create or resume isolated customer-use hosted KYC securely

Targeted server and UI regressions, production build, SAST and Reticle produce observed evidence; provider-dependent limitations are stated
